name: sms
description: Send SMS messages via Twilio. Requires NLS_TWILIO_SID, NLS_TWILIO_TOKEN, and NLS_TWILIO_FROM.

manual.overview: Use SMS when you need guaranteed delivery to a phone number for alerts, OTPs, or urgent notifications. Works without internet on the recipient side and has high open rates. Requires Twilio account and credentials.
tips: Use E.164 format for to: +country_code + number, no spaces (e.g. +15551234567)
SMS has a 160-character limit for single-segment; longer messages split and may cost more
NLS_TWILIO_FROM must be a verified Twilio number or short code
Reserve SMS for high-priority messages; costs apply per segment
edge_cases: Invalid or unverified Twilio numbers cause immediate failure; check NLS_TWILIO_SID, NLS_TWILIO_TOKEN, NLS_TWILIO_FROM
Some countries have carrier restrictions; verify Twilio supports the destination country
NLS_TWILIO_AUTH may need to be base64(SID:TOKEN); check how your executor expects it
